newsitem.title: CANADA: CHUM files amended normal course bid notice.
newsitem.headline: CHUM files amended normal course bid notice.

text.p: CHUM Ltd said on Friday it filed an amended notice of intention to make a normal course issuer bid for its common shares and non-voting class B shares which amended the average price paid for class B shares to C$18.22 per share from the originally stated C$8.22 per share.
CHUM said the restated notice, which was filed with the Toronto stock exchange, is identical in all other respects to the original notice.

CHUM said it intends to purchase up to 179,261 common shares, or five percent of the 3,585,231 common shares issued and outstanding and up to 676,948 non-voting class B shares, or 10 percent of the public float of the 8,481,151 class B shares currently issued and outstanding.
Purchase price will the market price at the time of the acquisition, CHUM said. It said the bid will begin on September 9, 1996 and end on September 8, 1997.
